notes.title: The fixes YOU asked for! + Refined blades? 👀
notes.notes:
We heard you ninjas! We’ve raised the quality bar this update with gameplay improvements and crucial bug fixes 🐛 Also, with tweaks made to blades, slicing has never been so satisfying! 🤩 Download now! 🍉🔪

Fruit Ninja, version 1.7.0.547897
- Fixed bug where some blades would not always unlock
- Fixed bug where game would be in German by default if the system language was Dutch
- New in-game HUD indicators to show fruit, bombs and enemy baskets outside of your field of view
- New achievements menu
- New visual effect when deflecting bombs
- More haptic feedback with blades
- Tweaked blades to have unique speed requirements to slice or push away fruit with different sides of the blade
- Settings menu improvements:
- Settings menu now shows in front of you instead of showing on your hand
- Added HUD indicators settings

notes.title: Have You Played Fruit Ninja VR?
notes.notes:
Have You Played? is an endless stream of game retrospectives. One a day, every day, perhaps for all time.

It’s hard not to feel cool when you’ve got a sword in each hand. Even if you only use them to chop fruit.

Fruit Ninja is a mobile game about slicing falling mangoes before they can touch the ground. Fruit Ninja VR is the same, but, yunno, in VR. It is a squillion times better.

(more…)

notes.title: Ninjas can now regulate the graphics.
notes.notes:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25334258/026b4049675e080932d45bbdd383f475b1505197.jpg[/img]

Just like wielding dual blades… in one hand the developers at Halfbrick are working hard on the next BIG THING for Fruit Ninja VR and in the other hand, we’ve just updated the game with a graphical adjustment option. 

Here is how you access the quality settings.
1. Press the [b]Menu[/b] button
2. Navigate to [b]Settings[/b]
3. Navigate to [b]Quality[/b]
4. Choose from:
 [list]
    [*][b]Fast[/b] (Lowest quality but runs fast)
    [*][b]Simple[/b] (In the middle of Fast and Good)
    [*][b]Good[/b] (Same as Best with no Screen Effects)
    [*][b]Best[/b] (Best quality Settings)
[/list]
5. The game will restart with your new graphics quality applied.

notes.title: The rare Bat Blades have been delivered.
notes.notes:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25334258/71cd71215ae1bc4084c3275f6ee8f68e75448789.jpg[/img]
This Halloween 400 Bat Blades were found by Sensei himself deep within a damp, dark basement not far from the Dojo.

No one really knows how they ended up there, who they once belonged to and the spookiest unanswered question yet is how long they’ve been a secret for? 

These swords that illuminate lime green in colour when a Ninja wields them during a blitz mode, were too enigmatic to be kept underground. They have made the perfect prize for the 400 top soul releasers in Fruit Ninja VR’s Possessed Pumpkin Tournament.

If there are players that think they should have received the Bat Blade but didn’t, please reach out to us so the dev team can investigate it.

Happy Halloween!

notes.title: New Update: Local Leaderboards
notes.notes:
Winning isn’t everything, it’s the only thing! This update introduces local leaderboards so you can finally settle the score with friends, family, and your closest rivals. We’re also working on a brand new game mode which is expected to drop soon. Watch this space for details!

To change your leaderboard settings:

1. Navigate to the main menu of the game
2. Press the menu button on your controller
3. Select "Settings" and then "Leaderboards"
4. Choose your preferred leaderboard type

We plan on changing how the leaderboards are displayed (and the settings menu) in the near future, so this process will improve as development progresses. Keep the feedback coming!

We also tweaked the position of the side fruit pillars in Arcade mode.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25334258/e9d96d549f40993f655bb0ee51fdc21fb81ab7bb.png[/img]

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25334258/dd14277b8a0d512b34f04067491ea0d5b60f8cfb.png[/img]

notes.title: Fruit Ninja VR Cuts Into Early Access On Vive
notes.notes:
The Vive does not play nicely with my Eagle-Eyes, let alone my Kung-Fu Grip, but I can still enjoy watching other people play with Valve’s cybergoggles. Flailing. I enjoy watching people flailing. So I’m quite excited to see Halfbrick Studios have brought their five-a-day ‘em up Fruit Ninja over from pocket telephones to Vive. Watching a friend wave their arms while shouting at an imaginary mango is the stuff of my dreams. Fruit Ninja VR [official site] seems a great fit for Vive’s motion controllers too, and control looks tight enough to even juggle fruit with your swords. Watch this trailer:

… [visit site to read more]
